title: trachymene humilis subsp. breviscapa
intro: Trachymene humilis subsp. breviscapa, commonly known as the Dwarf Trachymene or Short-stemmed Trachymene, is a plant species in the carrot family (Apiaceae). It is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate conditions such as arthritis, fever, and gastrointestinal issues. The therapeutic actions of Trachymene humilis subsp. breviscapa include its ability to reduce inflammation, fight off infections, and support the immune system. Research has identified the bioactive constituents of this plant, including alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
